column3: Close to the Hebrew; “insult” is rendered “blasphemy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “taunt” is rendered “reproach,” and “which is found” “that is left.”
Close to the Hebrew; “put a spirit in him” is rendered “send a spirit upon him,” and “report” “rumor.”
Close to the Hebrew; מֶלֶךְ־ כּוּשׁ (Cush) is rendered “Ethiopia.”
Close to the Hebrew; לָעִיר (“city”) is rendered “the city of.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural “letters” is rendered “the letter.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sits [on] the cherubim” is rendered “dwells between the cherubim.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all the lands and their land” is rendered “all the nations and their lands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “mocked” is rendered “laughed you to scorn.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pines” is rendered “cypress trees,” and “the forest of its orchard” “its fruitful forest.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the canals of Egypt” (matsor) is rendered “the brooks of defense.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a field before standing grain” is rendered “grain blighted before it is grown.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your sitting down” is rendered “your dwelling place.”
Close to the Hebrew; “arrogance” is rendered “tumult.”
